customerProblem: Free Hive wallets mark thin Hive Engine positions from a latest or best price, while a holder needs to know how much of a named liquid quantity the complete displayed bid book can actually absorb, at which weighted price, and whether independent public providers agree on the underlying state.
customerPromise: For one public Hive account, one Hive Engine symbol, and one immediately liquid quantity, return either an witnessed full-depth gross SWAP.HIVE exit calculation or a typed refusal naming provider contest, insufficient witnesses, truncated depth, or locked inventory.

formulae.knowledge: FOUR: true means at least two declared providers support one exact position and live book; both means incompatible states are positively witnessed; neither means independent evidence is insufficient; no valuation is emitted for both or neither.

request.symbol: one Hive Engine token other than SWAP.HIVE
request.quantity: canonical nonnegative token quantity; omission selects the currently liquid balance

response: exact liquid, staked, delegated-out, pending-unstake, and pending-undelegation compartments
staking, delegation, unstaking, undelegation, and release-count terms
complete-depth gross proceeds, coverage, VWAP, marginal floor, and levels consumed
best-price mark and its exact gap from complete-depth proceeds
provider state digests and FOUR knowledge state
explicit limits: displayed depth is not future execution; SWAP.HIVE is not asserted equal to HIVE, HBD, or USD

priorArtAdopted.adoption: Keep solicitation, exact terms, provider-authored evidence, and performance receipt distinct; the local probe does not pretend the payment gateway exists.
Treat endpoint exhaustion and public observations as bounded evidence, not as cost basis, tax treatment, or intrinsic price.
Make provider contest and retention limits typed outcomes instead of filling gaps with zero or a chosen fair value.
Integrate complete displayed depth rather than multiplying an entire position by a shallow top bid.
Sell the witnessed boundary and honest refusal rather than repackaging freely visible balances.

freeSubstitutes.capability: multi-account token summaries and account value

freeSubstitutes.name: Signet
freeSubstitutes.capability: Hive Engine balances, stake/delegation compartments, price charts, and USD portfolio value

freeSubstitutes.capability: Hive Engine portfolio valuation and token actions

demandEvidence.observation: A current Hive user reports low liquidity, large spreads, and positions that can take weeks to exit.
A current active trader manually exports open-order HTML to a spreadsheet because the interface does not total it.
A live analytics discussion demonstrates how thin-pool dimensions and cumulative volume can be misread as price or 24-hour volume.

currentMarketAssay.differentiation: Not another wallet or mark-to-last-price dashboard: a content-addressable, witnessed, quantity-specific answer about executable displayed bid depth and lock state, including a priced refusal when evidence is contested.

commercialExperiment.priceHypothesis: 0.250 HBD per report for five invoice-first manual slots; exact x402 on Base remains a later distribution option only after Hive-native willingness-to-pay is observed
commercialExperiment.settlementProvider: For the five-report assay, require a separately confirmed native Hive HBD transfer after an invoice and bind it to the delivered report digest; if demand survives, contract the existing sovereign x402-services-section rather than copying protocol authority into Aagaard.
commercialExperiment.sellerGateway: No broad gateway is funded before one paid request. The public Hive post supplies discovery and exact invoice-first terms; a read-only three-provider monitor distinguishes comments from invoices, payments, delivery, and revenue.
commercialExperiment.revenueRecognition: zero until an outside payment is independently settled and joined to the exact delivered report digest

distributionPlan.formula: required RC is twice the live average custom_json cost; regeneration time is ceil((required-current)*432000/max)
distributionPlan.refusedAlternatives: The author cannot provide marginal self-distribution; every other RC-ready fleet account has fewer than the ten-follower minimum.
distributionPlan.liveBadIncumbentProof: An execute request with an intentionally nonexistent key returned resource-credit-wait without credential access or chain mutation.

commercialExperiment.successRule: At least one non-fleet buyer accepts an invoice, settles exactly 0.250 HBD, receives the exact report, and the payment is joined to its digest.
commercialExperiment.stopRule: After the post payout window, stop or reframe the pilot if it has no qualifying external request; do not build the x402 gateway from views, votes, or pending author payout alone.

claimsExcluded: No promise that displayed orders remain available or that an actual order fills.
No fair value, intrinsic value, cost basis, profit, income, tax, or investment recommendation.
No equivalence claim between SWAP.HIVE and native HIVE, HBD, USD, or USDC.
No credential access, custody, signing, broadcast, order placement, or asset movement.
